lesson_text: D01_IdioVol as standalone defense sleeve fails MDD hard gate (53.7% > 45%) despite statistically significant factor signal (ICIR 0.333, IC t=5.30, FMB t=2.63). Key paradox: defense sleeve MDD (53.7%) exceeds BM MDD (52.9%), and BM correlation (0.816) is too high for diversification. Ang et al. (2006) IdioVol puzzle works as alpha signal (positive IC) but does NOT provide defensive properties when used alone. IdioVol selects low-idiovol stocks which are typically large-caps tracking the market closely — hence high BM correlation and no MDD reduction. Condition: IdioVol alone cannot serve as defense sleeve; must combine with explicit low-beta or min-variance factors to achieve defense role. Recent 3Y improvement (SR 0.897) suggests the signal is strengthening but cannot overcome the structural MDD problem.
core_reference: Ang, Hodrick, Xing, Zhang (2006) 'The Cross-Section of Volatility and Expected Returns' — IdioVol puzzle as alpha source. QEPM §10 statistical defense (ICIR > 0.20 confirmed). V7 Cycle 3 Phase 1 defense sleeve test.

conditions.when_valid: IdioVol signal is statistically significant (ICIR 0.333) in Korean market 2005-2026
conditions.when_invalid: Standalone IdioVol does NOT provide defense (MDD > BM, high BM corr). Must combine with low-beta/min-var.
conditions.context: V7 pipeline defense sleeve evaluation, S1 pure factor (no overlay)
